subject: Reevaluate Q3 commitment — next steps from discovery
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya@olivetech.com>, Oliver Greene <oliver.greene@olivetech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Reevaluate Q3 commitment — next steps from discovery

Hi Maya / Oliver,

Great to meet this morning — thanks for carving out time. Quick recap from our discovery and suggested next steps so we don’t lose momentum heading into the quarter close: 

Key takeaways:
- Use case: customer support triage + knowledge retrieval for 6 product lines (heavy PDF docs, user guides)
- Initial footprint: 3 production agents, ~150k tokens/day expected during peak
- Success metric: 30% reduction in average handle time (pilot) + acceptable latency under 350ms p95
- Compliance ask: SOC 2 evidence and private deployment option for PII-sensitive workloads

Suggested next steps (my ask):
1) Confirm budget owner and procurement window (PO or contract by end of Q3?)
2) Share any mandated security checklist items we should pre-fill (we have SOC2 scoping docs attached)
3) Quick technical sync (15–20m) next week to align on ingest format and sequencing

Attachments: Redwood-olive-TEI-draft.pdf (TEI/ROI sketch), pricing-summary-olive.xlsx (starter pricing + seat tiers).

If your timeline shifted and this got deprioritized for Q3, no problem — please let me know so I can adjust our recommendations and timing.

Proposed slots (PST): Wed 8/25 10:00am, Thu 8/26 2:00pm. If neither work, suggest a single time and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0192
